proposal_summary: Changed ContextCompiler._find_task_contract in context.py to walk agent-system/ with os.walk, pruning the agent-system/runtime directory out of dirnames in place so it is never descended into, listed, or opened, then examines the remaining *.json files in sorted path order exactly as before. Added a new test module, test_context_runtime_exclusion.py, covering: a matching contract under runtime being ignored in favor of the real one; the real contract winning even when the runtime copy's path would sort first; identical behavior when no runtime directory exists; the existing PlanningError with the required message when the only copy is under runtime; and a read_text-patching test proving runtime files are never opened. No existing test or any file outside the two permitted paths was modified.
